correctness.rationale: Necessity is witnessed by FO exact-j colour-class existence whose probability is 1-(1-p_j)^m and p_j -> 0. Adjacent intensity ratio diverges, allowing at most one fixed positive finite critical intensity; multinomial pgf gives two independent Poisson rare types, while Markov and binomial variance force other fixed types to vanish or abound. A q-round EF strategy matches truncated per-block colour supplies and truncated block-type populations. This proves sufficiency for every FO rank and identifies the full threshold-event spectrum, with definability in the reverse direction. Exact finite computations corroborate the finite identities and q<=2 strategy, not the infinite theorem.
